Hi Laura,

Thanks for the follow up. Finance has put a credit hold on Redwood invoices — we still haven't received a copy of our Purchase Order (PO 98765) tied to this billing period. Without a PO we can’t release payment. Also, our tax team flagged that we need a VAT certificate from Redwood for the reverse-charge process (we sent a formal request last week).

We’ll remove the hold and approve payment once we have: the signed PO (Hearthway_PO_98765.pdf) and your VAT certificate. Can you escalate internally for a short-term exception? This invoice is for a live feature we can’t take offline.

Best,

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 13:47:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Invoice 202611-HEARTH-001 — overdue notice / escalation request

Team — forwarding Hearthway's response. They’ve placed a credit hold pending PO and VAT certificate. They explicitly asked for escalation to remove a block for a live feature.

Quick summary:
- Outstanding: $138,200 (INV-202611-HEARTH-001)
- External asks: signed PO (they attached PO 98765) and Redwood VAT certificate for reverse charge
- Business risk: product functionality at risk if payment blocked; AM (Laura) says customer will pause usage if hold persists.

Options:
1) Provide VAT certificate and ask Finance to accept PO as commercial approval (fast).
2) Accept short-term partial release (e.g., 50%) pending full docs.
3) Hold to policy and escalate to legal if PO mismatch.

Markus — can you advise if we can make a one-time exception or do we need CEO-level approval? Evelyn, if we offer a 30/60 split payment plan, can CS/the AM keep the feature live while collection completes?

Thanks — Soojin
So in Lee
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0199
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Invoice 202611-HEARTH-001 — overdue notice / escalation request

Soojin / team —

I reviewed the file and Hearthway's PO is legitimate; their PO number matches our SOW. We are missing the VAT certificate which is the blocker for their tax team to do reverse charge. Finance can approve a one-time 40% partial payment release on the condition that:

- Hearthway returns signed PO 98765 (we have copy but need their internal confirmation)
- They sign a short payment plan to cover remaining balance within 30 days (we’ll draft)
- Redwood provides the VAT certificate or a W9-equivalent VAT doc attached to the invoice folder

I’m authorizing the partial release under the contingency above. Evelyn, please work with Laura to keep the feature active and capture a written confirmation from Hearthway that usage continues under the payment plan.

Markus Klein
VP Finance, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

Attachment: proposed_payment_plan.xlsx

Subject: Payment plan proposal and VAT docs — Redwood (INV-202611-HEARTH-001)

Hi Marta / Hearthway team,

Thanks for the quick reply and for attaching PO 98765. Per Markus (VP Finance) we can do a one-time partial release of 40% of the outstanding balance while we close the VAT paperwork. Our finance team has also attached the VAT certificate (VAT_cert_hearthway.pdf) and a proposed payment plan for the remaining 60% to be settled within 30 days.

To confirm:
- Redwood will process 40% payment on receipt of Hearthway's signed confirmation of PO 98765.
- Hearthway signs the attached proposed_payment_plan.xlsx agreeing to the remaining schedule.
- We will keep the service active pending sign-off and receipt of the first partial payment.

Please reply with a signed PO confirmation and the signed payment plan. I’ll route the release to payments once we have both.

Best,
Soojin Lee
